lore_anchors.definition: A major competitive event in the mortal realm where Qi Condensation cultivators from various powers compete for limited spots in immortal sects. Often a bloody affair with low success rates.

A major realm in cultivation representing a fundamental transformation of the body and spirit. Reaching it is a near-insurmountable wall for most cultivators, requiring rare Foundation Establishment Pills and immense fortune.

cultural_notes_faq.q: Why does the fourth brother’s recognition shock everyone so much?
cultural_notes_faq.a: In the Mortal Stream, climbing from Qi Condensation to Foundation Establishment in a decade is seen as basically impossible without monstrous resources or luck. His speed implies he’s a terrifying anomaly that breaks the known rules.

cultural_notes_faq.q: What is the significance of the box the young woman is holding?
cultural_notes_faq.a: It is almost certainly a sealed communication device related to the Blood Curse (血咒) or a similar control mechanism. Her attempt to open it is an act of betrayal, signaling an intent to report or sabotage the mission.

cultural_notes_faq.q: Why does the dark-faced elder immediately order her to hand over the box?
cultural_notes_faq.a: He recognizes that the trap has been sprung and that loyalty has been broken. His priority shifts from alliance to damage control—he must prove to Han Li that he is not complicit in the betrayal to survive.
